nav.stepTabTooltip: Jump to this step of the batch indexing wizard.
nav.previousTooltip: Go back to the previous wizard step.
nav.nextTooltip: Advance to the next wizard step.

step1.title: Add EBSD Files
step1.addFolderTooltip: Scan a folder for EBSD files and add them to the batch.
step1.hint: Click "Add Folder" to scan for EBSD files

step2.title: Pattern Center (PC)
step2.refreshPcTooltip: Re-read the pattern center (PC) for all files from headers/refinement.
step2.openPcRefinementTooltip: Open the PC Refinement page to fit the pattern center precisely.
step2.footer: Use PC Refinement page, then "Apply PC" in the file tree sidebar to copy to other files.

step3.frameAveragingTooltip: Average neighbouring patterns to reduce noise before indexing.
step3.frameAveragingWindowTooltip: Choose the neighbourhood window size used for frame averaging.
step3.backgroundRemovalTooltip: Remove the static/dynamic background from each pattern before indexing.
step3.backgroundMethodTooltip: Select dynamic or static background-removal method.
step3.preprocessingNote: Applied to all files (Hough + Dictionary only — Spherical reads raw patterns from disk).
step3.postprocessingIntro: Removes false-positive pixels from the winning-phase map after indexing. Applied to _multiphase.h5 before exports — so .ang/.ctf/Phase Map all see the cleaned result. Leave at 0 to keep raw assignment.
step3.ciThresholdTooltip: Drop pixels below this confidence index (CI) during post-processing cleanup.
step3.uncertaintyThresholdTooltip: Drop pixels whose orientation uncertainty exceeds this value.
step3.minClusterSizeTooltip: Remove phase clusters smaller than this many pixels as noise.
step3.postprocessingRecommendation: Recommendation for noise-prone multi-phase: CI ~0.1, Uncertainty ~0.05, Cluster 3–5.
step3.autoExportTooltip: Automatically write result files when each indexing job finishes.
step3.lightH5Desc: indexing data only, no pattern copy — small, needed for in-app Phase Map / Analysis / Refinement
step3.lightH5Tooltip: Export a small HDF5 with indexing data only (no pattern copy).
step3.richH5Desc: copies the source file — size = source size per result!
step3.richH5Tooltip: Export full HDF5 copying the source file — size equals source per result.
step3.includeEdsDesc: per-element counts + X/Y + header (small). Raw spectra stay in the source file.
step3.includeEdsTooltip: Copy per-element EDS counts + X/Y + header into the light .h5.
step3.outputDirTooltip: Set the output folder for exports (empty = next to source file).
step3.browseTooltip: Pick the export output folder via a dialog.

step4.methodTooltip: Choose the indexing method for the whole batch.
step4.refreshTooltip: Rescan the phase database — use after simulating a new phase in the Simulation module
step4.autoRescanNote: Auto-rescans when you return to this tab.
step4.phaseChipTooltip: Select or deselect this phase for indexing.
step4.applyToAllTooltip: Assign the selected phases to every file in the batch.

step5.bandwidthTooltip: Set the spherical-harmonic bandwidth for Spherical indexing.
step5.nRegionsTooltip: Set the number of correlation regions for Spherical indexing.
step5.refineTooltip: Refine each orientation after Spherical indexing.
step5.keepNTooltip: Keep the top-N dictionary matches per pixel.
step5.metricTooltip: Choose the similarity metric (NCC or NDP) for Dictionary indexing.
step5.nBandsTooltip: Set the number of Hough bands detected per pattern.

step6.title: Queue
step6.startBatchTooltip: Run pre-flight checks and start indexing all ready files.
step6.noReadyFiles: No ready files. Each file needs PC + at least one phase.

fileTree.removeFromBatchTooltip: Remove this file from the batch.
fileTree.fileRowTooltip: Select this file as the active file for editing and copying config.
fileTree.fileCheckboxTooltip: Check this file as a target for Apply PC / Apply All actions.
fileTree.openInViewerTooltip: Open the active file in the EBSD Viewer (loads patterns, EDS, overview)
fileTree.setPcManuallyTooltip: Set PC values manually for the active file
fileTree.applyPcSelectedTooltip: Copy pattern center from active file to all checked files
fileTree.applyAllSelectedTooltip: Copy all configuration (PC, preprocessing, phases, ROI) from active file to all checked files
fileTree.msgInvalidPc: Invalid PC values — must be three numbers

dashboard.title: Batch Progress
dashboard.connectionError: ⚠ Lost connection to backend. Polling stopped — check that the backend is still running.

results.title: Open Results
results.intro: Analysis / Phase Map load the .ang export. Refinement reads the _multiphase.h5 checkpoint next to the source.

status.skipped: Resumed from checkpoint — not re-indexed this run. CI shown comes from the previous run.

setupDialog.title: Batch Indexing Setup
setupDialog.folderPlaceholder: Select a folder containing EBSD files...
setupDialog.noPhaseFilesForMethod: No phase files found for {{method}}. Make sure phase files are available in the crystal database.

hoverTips.pcXInput: Pattern center PCx (detector-fractional, 0–1) for the active file.
hoverTips.pcYInput: Pattern center PCy (detector-fractional, 0–1) for the active file.
hoverTips.pcZInput: Pattern center PCz / detector distance (detector-fractional, 0–1) for the active file.
hoverTips.pcDialogCancel: Discard the manual PC values and close this dialog.
hoverTips.pcDialogApply: Apply these manual PC values to the active file.
hoverTips.pauseBatch: Pause indexing after the current job; resume later from this point.
hoverTips.resumeBatch: Resume the paused batch from where it stopped.
hoverTips.stopBatch: Stop the batch — running jobs finish, no new ones start.
hoverTips.viewReport: Open the batch HTML report in your browser.
hoverTips.openRefinement: Open this file in Refinement (reads the _multiphase.h5 checkpoint next to the source).
hoverTips.openAnalysis: Open this file in Analysis (loads the .ang/.ctf/light .h5 export).
hoverTips.openPhaseMap: Open this file in Phase Map (loads the .ang/.ctf/light .h5 export).
